context: A uni intern interviews a manager about compliance
purpose: Teach: 主任/取り付け/採択/円滑/送付/法務省/官庁/査定

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業務の流れ、官庁との連携部分を教えていただけますか。
lines.en: Could you walk me through how the workflow coordinates with government agencies?
lines.style: Respectful, careful diction. Leaning slightly forward in posture—earnest note-taker mode. Steady pace, no rushing. Genuine curiosity without performance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 主任が窓口になり、法務省への送付前に社内査定を通します。
lines.en: Our manager handles the contact point. We run everything through internal review before sending it to the Justice Ministry.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. Light emphasis on the procedural sequence—not lecturing, just clarifying the chain. Warm professional tone. Steady eye contact, inviting follow-up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 採択率、企業によって差がありますよね。
lines.en: So adoption rates differ by company, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing gently. Slight lilt upward on the question, testing Yuki's openness. Not challenging—genuinely wondering if she'll share more.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うちは円滑な調整に力を入れているので、比較的高いです。
lines.en: We do. We put real effort into smooth coordination, so our rates stay relatively high.
lines.style: Slight note of quiet pride, not boastful. A small deliberate pause before 'smooth coordination' to emphasize it's something deliberate. Confident but grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: システムの取り付けも、官庁監修なんですか。
lines.en: And does the ministry supervise the system installation too?
lines.style: Precise, surgical follow-up. Ren homing in on the detail that matters. Not rushed. Respectful interest—he's building a map and wants the accurate piece.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。安全基準の確認まで含めて、徹底されています。
lines.en: Yes. Including safety-standard verification—it's all rigorous oversight.
lines.style: Finishing the explanation with clarity and finality. A note of professional assurance that this is serious business. Breath support to the end of the sentence, no trailing-off.
